_comment: The SHAPE of deploy/load/tokens.json (gitignored). Do not fill it by hand:
`python -m app.ops.mint_load_tokens mint --count 500` writes it with REAL
Firebase ID tokens (README §2). Condition (1) of docs/capacity-plan.md §0.1:
a stub authenticator reproduces 07-nfr-slo §2's existing number and measures
nothing, because the auth path IS bottleneck ح‑2.
`stub` is a declaration, not a switch. Setting it true does not change what
the harness sends; it marks the archived result invalid so a harness smoke
run can never be mistaken for a baseline.
Size the pool from the profile: peak holds 1,500 sockets and §0 derives them
as 500 users x 3 tabs, so a peak run needs at least 500 distinct users.
`lib/profile.js`'s guard refuses a pool that would exceed 3 sockets per user.
`space_id` must be a space the SEED filled (seed-space-0/1), not an empty one:
four scenarios out of five are scoped to it. `space_name`/`space_files`/
`space_conversations` record what it held when `refresh` last looked; k6
ignores them, `verify` refuses a pool whose spaces hold nothing.
